items.title: Financial Select Sector SPDR (XLF) Buys $26.7 Million More Berkshire on Nov. 9
items.summary: The fund added $202.9 million across all 76 of its positions on Monday, with Berkshire Hathaway and JPMorgan leading the buys.

items.title: Spdr Dow Jones Industrial Average ETF (DIA) Buys $40.3 Million More GS on Nov. 9
items.summary: The fund added $392.3 million across all 30 of its positions, with Goldman Sachs its largest buy at $40.3 million.
